concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-in-person-guides-reporting-and-reconciliation]] - 2026-09-16 unversioned Braintree In-Person website snapshot for qualified pass-through settlement/funding timing, POS-provided `orderId` correlation, preconfigured searchable custom fields and account-structure-variable sample reports; lifecycle and field constraints remain routed to linked authorities, and reporting is not payment, settlement, funding, deposit or reconciliation proof
warnings: Keep the T+2 statement card-scheme-, weekday- and example-qualified; do not make it a universal funding promise.
Treat `orderId` as the POS-provided report-correlation field documented on this page, not as a reader ID, In-Store Context ID, guaranteed Braintree transaction ID, or final lifecycle status.
Preserve the merchant-account custom-field configuration prerequisite and do not universalize the example Store ID, Terminal ID or Cashier ID names.
Report visibility, searches and sample files are not proof of authorization, capture, settlement, funding, bank arrival, completeness or successful reconciliation.
